$comment: Every Python environment this OS depends on, and which kind it is. Operational = something the hub, lead discovery or memory needs running (a break stops real work). Experimental = a pilot, trial or throwaway (a break must never reach anything operational). scripts/ops/python-envs.ts validates this file in the test suite; docs/programme-20261001/DEPENDENCY-ISOLATION.md explains the rules and why (the OpenShell experiment's Python 3.13 to 3.14 upgrade orphaned SearXNG's venv on 2 Oct 2026). Paths use forward slashes.

environments.knownRisk: Built with virtualenv on the distro's python3, so a distro Python upgrade orphans it. Rebuild it from a pinned interpreter (see DEPENDENCY-ISOLATION.md) the next time it is touched.

environments.rule: Lives under ~/experiments/, never installs into the distro Python, and never upgrades or replaces the distro's python3.
